Gulshan Kumar & T-Series Presents “Hare Krishna Hare Rama” - video song, produced by Bhushan Kumar, This Janmashtami Special Release is sung by Jubin Nautiyal music composed by Shabbir Ahmed and penned by Shabbir Ahmed & Ayaz Kohli. The video is directed by Lovesh Nagar. The video is featuring Pritam Singh, Hetvi Sharma & Khushi Saxena. Celebrate Krishna Janmashtami 2021 singing Hare Krishna Hare Rama!! Enjoy & stay connected.
Stream the Full Song Here
